scripts.dev:api: uv run --package comfyshop-api fastapi dev apps/api/src/comfyshop_api/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8688
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package comfyshop-api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.start: pnpm db:migrate && uv run --package comfyshop-api fastapi run apps/api/src/comfyshop_api/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8688
scripts.api:generate: uv run --package comfyshop-api python tooling/export-openapi.py && openapi-typescript packages/api-client/openapi.json --default-non-nullable false -o packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts && prettier --write packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts packages/api-client/src/runtime-contract.ts packages/api-client/openapi.json && uv run --package comfyshop-api ruff format integrations/skills/comfyshop/scripts/comfyshop.py
scripts.check: node packages/tokens/build.mjs --check && tsc --noEmit && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && pyright --warnings && node tooling/verify-boundaries.mjs && knip --no-progress && uv run --all-packages ruff check --no-cache apps/api libs integrations tooling && uv run --all-packages vulture && node tooling/check-styles.mjs css && node tooling/check-styles.mjs tokens
scripts.check:infra: actionlint && hadolint Dockerfile && shellcheck tooling/docker-entrypoint.sh integrations/comfyui/standalone/start.sh integrations/comfyui/standalone/start.command
scripts.test:python: turbo run build --filter=@comfyshop/web && uv run --all-packages pytest
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --all-packages ruff format apps/api libs integrations tooling/*.py
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --all-packages ruff format --check apps/api libs integrations tooling/*.py
